value.rationale: The theorem isolates a sharp and physically motivated distinction between abrupt random tumble and smooth rotational diffusion at identical dipolar persistence. It proves a nontrivial all-time covariance shape invariance plus a strict all-rate variance gap governed by a hidden second angular mode. The ratio has a meaningful rare-turn divergence, and pairwise observations can identify the first two angular modes. It is a complete structural relation, not an arbitrary parameter evaluation.
